reason: The cited evidence supports that SLM CoCrFeNiMn can be optimized for density and that fatigue induces nano-twins which enhance ductility in this alloy. However, no evidence is provided for applying this as a coating on MnNiSi, for the coating improving the mechanical performance of the MnNiSi substrate, or for retaining the magnetocaloric effect, which are key premises of the hypothesis.
premises: CoCrFeNiMn HEA can be processed by SLM to high density with optimized parameters
Fatigue of SLM CoCrFeNiMn induces nano-twins
Fatigue-induced nano-twins in CoCrFeNiMn enhance ductility
Coating MnNiSi with CoCrFeNiMn will improve mechanical performance
The coating will not degrade the magnetocaloric effect of MnNiSi
